sections.title: Programme philosophy
paragraphs: The goal is not simply to return to work. It is to return with a renewed mind, a stronger character, a healthier attitude, and a deeper understanding of the privilege and responsibility of being a Zura Therapist.
This two-week transformation break is designed for a therapist who needs behavioural, emotional, and professional realignment.

It is not intended as punishment or psychological treatment. Instead, it is a structured opportunity for self-reflection, personal growth, renewed motivation, and a deliberate decision about returning to the Zura Spa team.
